text.text_excerpt: The wings are great! Cooked to perfection with lots of yummy sauce. I had the buffalo because i love *spice*, and my girlfriend had the kimchi. Both sauces were amazing and really took the concept of wings to the next level. Drinks are good too and made with all natural ingredients unlike lots of other daqs you will find around the city. The decor and tvs are nice and much cleaner than those of the previous establishment at this location. It was expensive for wings and beer but you definitely pay for quality here. Will be back for moarrr wingggsss and to try some of the meat they butcher there.

I honestly have to say that the wings here are solid. I mean, can you get any more casual deliciousness from a home-made daiquiri and home-made wing joint? You could literally taste the freshness in the daiquiri. Oh, I have no idea how they were able to develop so much smoke flavor in those delicious wings - but I am a fan! And that blue cheese sauce is wicked.

Yay! Bourrée moved into their permanent digs next to Boucherie....and it's great. They now offer jerked wings and smoked and seasoned dry wings in addition to the kimchi, sweet bbq and classic buffalo. The fries are a delicious new menu item, though I'd like to see them seasoned just a teeny bit lighter. Three daiquiri machines is an awesome upgrade from the temporary location and I'm sure the staff appreciated not having to hand make every single daiquiri ordered! The quality and flavor is still there. Speaking of the staff, I LOVE them. I want to be friends with Megan and Erin because they are just awesome. The crew at Bourrée is always friendly and fun.
